The current choice: cookie purposes from the anonymous subject (this browser), email
purposes from the signed-in customer (checkout origin). `text_version: null` means no choice
yet.

Records a choice for the anonymous subject (minted on the first choice) and, when signed in
on the checkout origin, for the customer. Answers the anonymous subject's new state.

get.summary: Product search with variant-correct facets (spec §11.1, A23).
get.description:
Results are distinct products; `variant_id` is the variant that matched best. Facets list
every value found for the query and category; `available: false` values would match
nothing with the other active filters and are shown disabled. No counts (A23).

parameters.name: X-Storefront-Token
parameters.description: The tenant's public storefront token.

parameters.name: X-Market
parameters.description: Market id resolved from the shop host by the edge.

parameters.name: X-Locale
parameters.description: Locale hint (one of the market's locales).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text (≤ 200 characters). Empty: browse (e.g. a category listing).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page (results beyond the first 1000 are not available).

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: 1-48, default 24.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Only products in this category or its subcategories.

parameters.name: in_stock
parameters.description: Only variants that can be bought now.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Gross price bounds in minor units (inclusive).

parameters.name: f.{facet}
parameters.description:
Facet filters: `f.<facet key>=<value>`, repeatable (`f.opt.color=red&f.opt.color=blue`).
Keys are the `facets[].key` of a previous response. Values of one facet are OR-ed,
facets are AND-ed, and all of them must hold for one variant.

get.summary: Layout data: shop name, locale, markets, menus, consent config, messages, theme tokens.

parameters.name: X-Storefront-Token
parameters.description: The tenant's public storefront token.

parameters.name: X-Market
parameters.description: Market id resolved from the shop host by the edge.

parameters.name: X-Locale
parameters.description: Locale hint (one of the market's locales).

CacheHints.description: Cache hints the edge reads from every page model (spec §8.2, A2).

applied.description: Whether it applies to the cart right now.

available.description:
False when the variant is no longer sold (not priced, archived or sold out); such
lines are not part of the totals.

discount.description: This line's share of the coupon.

total.description: What the customer pays for the line (VAT included, after the coupon).

ship_to_country.description: Country whose VAT applies (checkout sets it; the market's first country until then).

total.description: Goods after the coupon, VAT included (shipping and payment arrive with checkout).

cart_token.description: Checkout-scoped cart capability (the edge sets it as the `__Host-cart` cookie).

ConsentChoice.description: A choice as posted to `/_p/consent` (the contract in `docs/decisions/consent-contract.md`).

text_version.description: The consent text version the person saw (`GET /shop` → `consent.text_version`).

preferences_url.description: The preferences page on the checkout origin.

text_version.description: Version of the consent texts; post it back with the choice (`POST /_p/consent`).
Text version of the latest choice; `None` = no choice yet (show the banner).

Currency.description:
Currencies used by EU markets: the euro and the member states' own currencies.
`BGN` is historic (Bulgaria adopted the euro on 2026-01-01) and kept for old documents.

recently_verified.description:
A password can be set without the current one right now (A5: signed in with an email
link within the last 10 minutes).

key.description: `opt.<code>`, `param.<key>` or `brand`; the filter key to send back.

available.description: Selecting it would still match something. Unavailable values are shown disabled (A23).

disabled.description: Selecting it would give no result (counts are not shown, A23).

href.description: The listing URL with this value toggled.

key.description:
Facet key (`opt.color`, `param.material`, `brand`); the listing query parameter is
`f.<key>` (`?f.opt.color=red`).

GpsrView.description: General Product Safety Regulation information (Regulation (EU) 2023/988, art. 19).

token.description: Single use, valid for 60 seconds, for `checkout.<shop>/start?h=`.

hero.description: Placeholder built from the catalog until CMS blocks exist (WP13).

Image.description:
An image with every generated width. Render `srcset` (AVIF) with a `sizes` that matches the
real slot; `src` is a JPEG/PNG fallback. `width`/`height` are the intrinsic size of the
largest variant (use them for the aspect ratio: no layout shift).

src.description: Fallback (JPEG or PNG) around 640 px wide.

ListingPage.description: A category page or search results.

query.description: The search query (absent on category pages).

redirect.description: Relative path on the checkout origin to land on after sign-in (default `/account`).

MoneyView.description: The API shape of an amount (spec §8.1): `{amount_minor, currency, formatted}`.

quantity.description: 1-999 (added to an existing line of the same variant).

status.description: `accepted`: double opt-in mail arrives with the newsletter module (M2, §11.5).

current_password.description: Required unless the session signed in with an email link within the last 10 minutes.

PriceView.description:
A selling price with its Omnibus reference (A18). `reference_price` and
`discount_percent` are present only when a reduction may be claimed; they are computed
against the lowest price of the 30 days before the reduction, never `compare_at`.

type.description: Always `about:blank`; `code` carries the specific error kind.

images.description: Up to two images: the main one and a second (hover) image.

price_varies.description: Variants differ in price: show the price as "from".

stock.description: The best state over the product's variants.

description_html.description: Sanitized server-side; the only HTML a theme may render unescaped.

variants.description: Variants sold in this market, in the merchant's order.

oneOf.description: Absent when nothing is in stock.

Purposes.description: Per-purpose choices: `None` = not asked (or not part of this choice).

ResolvedRedirect.description: What the edge needs to answer a redirect.

image.description: The first product image, in the list-sized variants (up to 640 px).

in_stock.description: At least one variant can be bought now.

price.description: Current price of the matched variant in the market (gross).

variant_id.description: The variant that matched best (e.g. the red one when filtering by red).

oneOf.description: Price span of the products matching the query and category (without facet filters).

total.description: Matching products (before rehydration dropped any that just became unavailable).

base_path.description:
`""` in the market's default locale, else `/<locale>` (spec §9.1). Page-model hrefs
already carry it; themes prefix the links they build themselves (`/search`,
`/p/<slug>`, `/_p/public/*`).

checkout_url.description:
The checkout origin (`https://checkout.<shop host>`, A1): account, order status and the
withdrawal form (`/withdraw`, A19) live there, not on the theme's origin.

oneOf.description: Free shipping from this order value; `None` until shipping methods exist (WP10).

locale.description: Active locale (`cs`); also the `lang` of pages.

locales.description: Locales of this market, the default first, each with its home page URL.

markets.description: The tenant's markets (other shops of the same merchant).

messages.description: Platform UI messages in the active locale (`cart.add` -> "Přidat do košíku").

tokens.description: Design tokens of the active theme (A6).

redirect.description: Relative path on the checkout origin to continue to.

rum_sample_rate.description: Share of consented page views that report Web Vitals (spec §9.6).

UnitPrice.description: Price per unit of measure (EU price indication directive), e.g. per 1 kg.

image_index.description: Index into `product.images` of this variant's first image.
